messages:
Sarah (Docs): Hey folks — opened a docs PR for Dedicated provisioning. Need a concrete example for tenant-level quota + autoscale policy so customers can copy-paste. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

Ben (Eng-Platform): Link looks good. Can you call out a terraform example for reserved pools? I have a snippet we can adapt.

Sarah (Docs): Yes please. Also the SLA wording around eviction during maintenance is a bit fuzzy. Current draft says 'best-effort notification' — feels weak. Thoughts?

Clara (Product): We should avoid 'best-effort'. Customers expect clarity. Proposal: 'Reserved pools are not subject to preemption; non-reserved capacity may be preempted per the Reserved Capacity Policy. See SLA table for guarantees.'

Ben (Eng-Platform): Agree with Clara. I'll add a concrete TF snippet. Draft snippet:```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics-pool"
  gpu_count = 4
  gpu_type = "A10G"
  isolation = "reserved"
}

resource "redwood_autoscale_policy" "analytics_scale" {
  pool_id = redwood_dedicated_pool.analytics.id
  min_replicas = 1
  max_replicas = 8
  target_utilization = 0.7
  scale_window_seconds = 120
}
```

Sarah (Docs): Nice, can you also add a short example for a per-tenant quota config? Something like quota limits + priority tiers.

David (DevEx): I'll add a Python SDK snippet + a CLI example. Python example:```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
client.create_pool(name="tenant-foo", gpus=2, isolation="shared", quotas={"tokens_per_minute": 1000})
```
CLI:```bash
redwoodctl dedicated create --name tenant-foo --gpus 2 --isolation shared --quota tokens_per_minute=1000
```

Eve (Eng-SRE): Quick heads up — the runbook link moved. Update any doc links to: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-provisioning (old link 404s). Also include a note about maintenance windows for regions.

Sarah (Docs): Thanks — I've updated the internal links in the PR. CI is failing on docs build with a markdown lint issue: `MD025/line-length` and a stray trailing space on line 123. Anyone can fix?

Ben (Eng-Platform): Fix pushed at 1923456795 — removed trailing whitespace and wrapped long lines. Also added the TF snippet and small isolation matrix CSV example.

Clara (Product): I reviewed the SLA wording update. One suggestion: include a short example scenario where reserved pool guarantees apply vs. shared. E.g., "If you reserve 4 GPUs for pool A, those GPUs will not be used for shared requests during normal ops."

Fiona (Legal): Quick skim — SLA phrasing acceptable, please ensure the SLA table still ties to the contract language. I can review the final copy before merge.

Ben (Eng-Platform): Added the example scenario and wired the SLA table to the contract clause link. Also included a small migration note: how to move workloads from shared to reserved (terraform + SDK steps).

deploy-bot: Preview deploy available: https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood.com 

Sarah (Docs): Awesome — everything looks green now. Thanks for the quick turnaround. I'll merge once Fiona gives final ok. Closing this thread after merge. :party_parrot:
